method: Firth (1993) penalised-likelihood logistic regression with profile penalised-likelihood 95% intervals (Heinze & Schemper 2002), odds ratio per standard deviation of each input; univariable models (one input; the others random) and the multivariable model; whether the maximum-likelihood estimate exists is reported. Proportions: Wilson score intervals.
caveat: the pathway model is deterministic: given all four inputs the outcome is fixed, and the intervals describe the 5,000-draw design, not a sampling process; with fewer than 10 events per variable (Peduzzi et al. 1996, J Clin Epidemiol 49, 1373) the multivariable odds ratios are indicative only
